spec.description: Disk space used per database. Bar is scaled relative to the largest database shown.
spec.title: Database sizes

spec.description: Per-database connection cap. -1 means unlimited (the default for every db in your current setup).
spec.title: Database connection limits (-1 = unlimited)

spec.description: Snapshot count of locks held, grouped by lock mode across all databases.
spec.title: Lock counts by mode
Replication / slot WAL lag over time

spec.description: pg_wal_segments reports segment count (unitless) and is intentionally kept off this bytes-scaled panel.
spec.title: WAL size on disk
Temp file bytes written, by database

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (pg_stat_activity_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", state=~"idle in transaction.*"})

spec.description: Sessions holding an open transaction while idle. Long-lived idle-in-transaction sessions block vacuum and often indicate an application bug, not a slow query per se.
spec.title: Idle-in-transaction sessions

spec.expr: sum by (instance, datname, state, wait_event_type) (pg_stat_activity_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) > 0

spec.description: Live snapshot of connections by state. For historical slow-query data (top queries by time/calls), see the 'Slow queries' row below.
spec.title: Current backend activity by state

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (pg_stat_database_numbackends{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (instance) (pg_settings_max_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})
topk(10, sum by (instance, datname, user, queryid) (rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])))

spec.description: queryid is a hash, not the SQL text (the exporter doesn't expose query text to avoid leaking literals into label cardinality). Look up the text with: SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <queryid>; Color = seconds of work per second of wall clock (like CPU load: 0.3 means this query alone keeps a core ~30% busy).
spec.title: Top 10 queries by total execution time (5m rate)

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, datname, user, queryid) (rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])) / sum by (instance, datname, user, queryid) (rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])))

spec.description: Total time / calls, per query — surfaces queries that are individually slow even if rarely called. Color thresholds: green < 1ms, yellow < 10ms, red >= 100ms.
spec.title: Top 10 queries by mean latency per call

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, datname, user, queryid) (rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])))

spec.description: Highest-frequency queries. High call rate + moderate per-call time can still dominate total load. Bar is scaled relative to the busiest query shown.
spec.title: Top 10 queries by calls/sec

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, datname, user, queryid) (rate(pg_stat_statements_rows_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])))

spec.description: Candidates for missing indexes or overly broad SELECTs/updates: queries moving the most rows. Bar is scaled relative to the top query shown.
spec.title: Top 10 queries by rows returned/affected per sec

spec.description: Seconds of query execution time consumed per second of wall clock, summed across all queries in a database. Can exceed 1 when queries run concurrently.
spec.title: Total query time by database (concurrency load)

spec.expr: sum by (instance, datname) (rate(pg_stat_statements_block_read_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m]) + rate(pg_stat_statements_block_write_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m]))

spec.description: Time spent by queries waiting on block reads/writes. High values relative to total execution time above point at disk I/O (not CPU/planning) as the bottleneck.
spec.title: Block I/O time by database (read + write)

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_xact_commit{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])) + sum by (instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m]))

sum by (instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])) / (sum by (instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])) + sum by (instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", datname=~"$datname"}[5m])))
